This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Rourkela Mahila P.S. Case No.5 of 2018 corresponding to Spl. G.R. Case No.20 of 2018 pending in the Court of learned Addl.
Sessions Judge - cum- Special Judge, Sundargarh for offences punishable under sections 376(2)(i)(n)/506/294 of the Indian Penal Code and read with section 6 of the POCSO Act.
The petitioner moved an application for bail // 2 // before the Court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge - cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Bargarh, which was rejected on 06.04.2022.

In pursuance of the order dated 12.05.2023, learned counsel for the State has obtained written instruction dated 16.05.2023 received from the Inspector in-charge of Mahila police station,
Rourkela to the effect that marriage of the petitioner with victim has not been solemnized before the Marriage Officer but they have applied through online for marriage on 15.04.2023 and the same was also verified from the victim and a written report was obtained to that effect and the online Samuel Hobo vs State Of Odisha & Another .... Opp. ...

1 application received from the Marriage Officer, Panposh was also verified and found it as correct.
The written instruction along with documents is taken on record.

Learned counsel for the State submitted that since one month from the date of application was over on 15.05.2023, now the petitioner and the victim can approach the Marriage Officer and after putting their signatures in the marriage register and on completion of necessary formalities,
marriage certificate will be issued in their favour.
In view of such submission and after hearing learned counsel for the State, the petitioner is granted interim bail till next date, which is fixed to 23rd June // 3 // 2023.
The petitioner shall surrender before the learned trial Court immediately on expiry of the above period.

For the above period, let the petitioner be released on interim bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further terms and conditions that while on interim bail, the petitioner shall not try to come in contact with any of the prosecution witnesses or tamper with the evidence, he shall not indulge in any criminal activities.
Violation of any terms and conditions shall entail cancellation of interim bail.
List this matter on 23rd June 2023.
Learned counsel for the petitioner shall produce the marriage certificate of the petitioner as well as the victim on the next date.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
